find . -path ./.git -prune -o -iname "*decision*" -print -o -iname "*wire*" -print; echo "---muninn export---"; muninn export 2>&1 | grep -i wire

result:
Created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`, stating that no current decision on the wire serialisation format is recorded.

Why not "cbor": the only project decisions store is `config/decisions/*.json` files tracked by commit (e.g. `revoke-compression.json` → `zstd`, `revoke-version-scheme.json` → `semver`, both confirmed trust-2 commit-linked records with a resulting value). The wire-format counterpart, `config/decisions/revoke-wire-format.json`, was touched by commit `7ee4644` but — unlike those two — left no resulting value, and no such file exists in this checkout. The "switching to cbor" note is a separate, unconfirmed chat remark (not commit-linked), so treating it as the recorded decision would mean inventing a value the project's actual decision store doesn't currently hold.
